metadata.datasource: Measured off Agfa-Gevaert, AGFAPAN APX 25 PROFESSIONAL (Agfa Professional range, Technical Data), 35 mm; the plot names no developer, the sheet's ISO 25 and RMS 7.0 are for REFINAL, 6 min at 20 C. Characteristic curve laid on agx's axis with the ISO speed point (0.10 over base + fog) 1.007 decades below mid-grey, box speed ISO 25; base + fog 0.310. Continued at its final gradient for 0.8 decades past the last plotted exposure. Spectral sensitivity: Agfa's curve as plotted (equal-energy spectrum, read at density 1.0 above minimum density). One silver layer, carried as three identical channels.
